text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, a computer uses training data to learn. This data includes examples with correct answers, called labels. The computer studies these examples and builds a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer make predictions about new information. For instance, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. After training, we test the model to see how accurate it is. Accuracy shows how often the model makes correct predictions. The better the training data, the more accurate the model can become.
